​⭐⭐⭐ Amazing food, great beach views, and exceptional hospitality!
​Balaji Beach Break is easily one of the best spots to chill right by Juhu Beach. The food here is absolutely delicious, especially their loaded Pav Bhaji and Tawa Pulao, which are perfect for a beach evening.
​What really made our visit memorable, though, was the incredible hospitality. The owner, Mohan Bhai, is such a humble and polite person. He personally made sure we were comfortable and enjoying our time. The rest of the staff was also quick, attentive, and very well-mannered. To top it all off, Mohan Bhai was kind enough to give us a sweet discount on our bill, which was such a generous gesture! Excellent food combined with heartwarming service—we will definitely be coming back here regularly. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Forking Mumbai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were recently at Juhu beach where we tried the food from Balaji Beach shack, they are well known for their iconic pav bhajis that are for sure Mumbai’s best pav bhajis one could ever try. Alongside the bay you can chill while trying out their food which not only consists of pav bhajis but more! Like pizza and pastas, they even have shakes, thick shakes, Chinese appetisers and Malai golas😍
We tried their Cheese pav bhaji- it was beyond perfect
Exotic pizza, it was a typical street style pizza, with veggies and cheese.
White sauce pasta, penne pasta, white sauce, and veggies, this one i liked more than the pizza.
Oreo shake, shake topped with ice-cream, and oreo biscuits
Mint mojito, refreshing drink and go to drink to sip alongside the bay, but try the oreo shake here that’s damn good.
And the best for the last- the chocolate malai gola! 😍 if you love golas you need to try them here.

All in all, you can definitely go here to chill and grab quick bites. Best time to visit- around 5-6pm

We started with salt and pepper winglets, which are chicken lollipops, and they were perfectly crispy and well-seasoned.
The veg dry Manchurian was flavourful without being too heavy.
Dynamite chicken was a standout dish with the right balance of spice and creaminess.
The Manchow soup was comforting and packed with flavour.
We also tried chicken dim sums, which were soft, juicy, and freshly made.
The Hakka noodles were simple, tasty, and cooked just right.
Overall, Chinfu is a solid spot for comforting and satisfying Indo-Chinese food in Juhu.

featured_reviews.name: Hina Beg Therapist
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a lovely breakfast experience at Fables! From the outside, I had no idea the place would open up into such a beautifully done café with warm and welcoming vibes. My kids introduced us to this place and took over the ordering and I must say, every single dish we tried was absolutely delicious. I’ll be sharing pictures of the bill as well, which has the names of all the items we ordered.
What truly caught my attention was the aesthetic décor. The wall adorned with books, the creative lamp made with stacked books, and the overall literary-themed interiors gave the café such a charming personality. Every corner felt thoughtfully designed and cozy.
The food, ambience, and overall experience made this breakfast outing extra special. Highly recommend Fables for a relaxed breakfast or brunch outing with family and friends. Do book your table in advance!

featured_reviews.name: Namiksha Karpe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Some places you visit for food, and some places you visit for the entire feeling, Fables in Juhu is definitely the second one. The moment you enter, it feels warm, cozy, and beautifully different. The book-themed décor, with pages and novels creatively stacked around, gives such a charming and aesthetic vibe. It’s the kind of place where you just want to sit, relax, and enjoy slow conversations.

We started with their drinks and honestly, each one was impressive. The Fresh Watermelon & Basil Cooler was super refreshing, the Cranberry & Lemongrass Mocktail had a lovely tangy twist, and the Lime & Cucumber Iced Tea felt light and cooling. featured_reviews.name: Vedant lad
featured_reviews.review_text: Dropped by this iconic place yesterday for lunch and we really loved it. Talking about the ambience firstly, fable have got indoor as well as outdoor dining areas, both of which look chic and aesthetic. All white decor with pretty retro elements and rustic corners gives you a perfect European cafe feeling. Coming to the F&B,  in drinks we tried Ferrero Rocher milkshake which was chocolaty and thick. From their coolers, we tried a couple of drinks like Watermelon & Basil, Pomegranate & Basil and lastly a virgin muddy mojito which was a classic virgin mojito made using brown sugar. All the coolers were super refreshing and we would totally recommend trying them out as they would be a perfect option to sip on this summer. From their breakfast menu, we tried the Chicken and Egg Sandwich in focaccia. Hands down one of the finest sandwich we have tried off late. Loaded with flavours and that super soft bread made every bite yum! We also tried their Teriyaki Chicken pizza which we had the option to choose from a thin/thick crust. We went with thick crust and it was fluffy, airy and very well made. The toppings were quite generous and this pizza would easily suffice 2-3 average eaters for a meal. Upon servers recommendation, we also tried their truffle mac n cheese which was served piping hot and it was super cheesy and had that evident earthy and musky flavour of truffle making it a rich and indulgent one. Lastly, we tried their stuffed chicken breast which was a chicken breast stuffed with spinach and mushrooms and served with mashed potatoes and sauteed veggies along with mushroom jus. An absolutely wholesome meal for one person.  For our sweet tooth cravings, we tried Philadelphia baked Cheesecake which was fresh and had that perfect melt-in-the-mouth texture and it was topped with blueberry compote making it even better.  A must try and we highly recommend trying this one. We also tried their Tiramisu which was good too having a perfect balance of sweetness and that bitter kick from the espresso. It was very well layered and would totally recommend it if your palate wants to have something that's not extremely sweet. Hospitality at Fable is 10/10! Captain Pramod made sure everything was on time and delivered the lovely service. Fable is truly one of those places where you can get in for a quick breakfast, slow lunches or even for dinner dates. This place has got you covered for all with their wide spread food options. We will surely visit again super soon.

A Vibrant Spot with a Kick: Blabber Juhu

​If you’re looking for a spot in Juhu that nails the "Instagrammable" aesthetic without sacrificing the quality of the meal, Blabber All Day is definitely worth a visit. Here is a breakdown of the experience:

​The decor is easily the highlight. It’s elegant, whimsical, and filled with soft pastel hues and floral accents. ​The Food & Drink

​The food is undeniably high-quality, though it’s worth noting that the kitchen leans toward a bolder, spicier flavor profile.

​The Caution: If you have a lower spice tolerance, you might find some dishes a bit intense.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Blabber All Day recently and had a great experience overall! One of the major plus points is their valet parking facility, which makes things so much easier in a busy area like this.

We had a reservation via Zomato, and thankfully we did—because the place was fully packed! Booking in advance really helped us avoid the wait.

Once seated, the service was very attentive. A modern touch I appreciated was that there’s no physical menu—each table has a QR code you can scan to order directly, including for cocktails, appetizers, and mains. Another thoughtful feature is the “ring for service” button on each table, which alerts the staff directly instead of having to call them over repeatedly—very convenient!

The ambience is chic and aesthetic, with dim lighting and a peaceful vibe, perfect for a relaxed evening.

Here’s what we ordered:
•	Cheesy Stuffed Mushrooms – Juicy with mild, flavorful stuffing. A good start.
•	Crackling Rolls (Sushi) – Absolutely mind-blowing! So good that we reordered.
•	Edamame Truffle Dim Sum – Wasn’t a fan of this one. It looked good but lacked the punch.
•	Berry Smoke Cocktail – Great presentation and a refreshing mix of berries and herbs.
•	Spaghetti Aglio Olio with Pepperoni – Taste was decent, but it was on the drier side.

The staff was friendly and efficient, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. I’d definitely recommend this place for a date night, an evening out with friends, family get-togethers, or even colleague dinners.

Tip: Make a reservation in advance to avoid waiting, and if you’re booking via Zomato, you can also avail 20% off when you pay through the app.

featured_reviews.name: melanie pais
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kerala Kitchen & Bar is hands down one of the most delightful dining experiences I’ve had in a long time.

From the very first sip to the last bite, everything was exceptional—the drinks were refreshing, the milkshakes indulgent, and every course that followed just kept getting better. The starters were packed with authentic flavours, the main course was rich and comforting, and the desserts were the perfect sweet ending. Truly, some of the best Kerala cuisine I’ve ever tasted.
What makes this place even more special is the ambience—it genuinely transports you to Kerala. Serene, beautiful, and thoughtfully designed, it creates a calming escape right in the middle of Juhu.
The staff deserves a special mention—warm, attentive, and incredibly kind, they make you feel right at home. It’s also wonderfully kid-friendly, making it perfect for family outings.
This is not just a one-time visit kind of place—I’ll definitely be coming back with family and friends. If you love great food, great vibes, and heartfelt hospitality, this one is an absolute must-visit.

Chemmeen manga curry was the hero of the afternoon. Tasty, tangy, full of prawns and raw mango. What's not to like. We paired them with freshly made appams and neer dosa.

Still, I'm definitely going back again to try some of their other items.

featured_reviews.name: Aaliyah Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Frisbee in Bandra, and here’s the honest take… it’s small, crowded, slightly chaotic… but the food makes it worth it.
We began with their super spicy chicken strips, and when I say spicy, I mean fire-level heat. Crispy on the outside, juicy inside, and unapologetically bold, definitely not for the faint-hearted.
Next came the mini sliders, which I absolutely loved. The chicken was tender, flavorful, and perfectly balanced within those soft buns. Bite-sized, but packed with taste.
The real highlight, though, was the Nashville chicken burger. I’ve tried Nashville style chicken at many places, but this one was on a completely different level. The spice, the crunch, the juiciness, everything just worked. Easily one of the best I’ve had. And their fries deserve credit too, golden, crisp, and addictive.
The drinks were fairly average, your standard mojitos and regular options. Nothing bad, just nothing extraordinary.

The only downside? Space. It’s a very small outlet, and you often end up waiting outside for an hour or more. Inside, it can feel quite congested. But once you get your food, the wait starts making sense.

featured_reviews.name: Clyde Baptista
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wraps & Rolls is a delivery Kitchen In Juhu Tara Road. The Menu of this Outlet Has limited options . They Have a Variety of choices when it comes to Rolls, Shawarma And Rice Bowls.

Had Ordered:
1) Smokey Chicken and Cheese Roll:5/5
2) Mexican Style Chicken and cheese Roll:5/5

Both the Rolls had a good stuffing of chicken and cheese . The Rolls served by this outlet are really good and tasty . Would Highly recommend to try the Rolls

3) Schezwan Style Chicken Rice Bowl:5/5
The Rice was very well cooked tossed in Schezwan Chicken Gravy. The Rice was a little spicy but it was very well cooked in Chinese spices.

Wraps and Rolls really maintained the standards when it comes to quality and quantity. The food was very well packed spill proof packing. And the delivery was quick and prompt (contactless delivery). Price was also economical. Really it was worth a price I spent.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wraps and Rolls a great outlet at Juhu. This outlet has some amazing options in so many varieties and they are all a must have. The food portion provided is excellent and great in terms of quality as well as quantity.
Tried the following:-
• Peri peri chicken roll:- The peri peri chicken roll was extremely amazing in terms of flavour and the quantity. Good amount of filling with the roll definitely recommended to try.
• Beiruti Chicken Shwarma Wrap:- Something different then the usual shwarma. Had great flavours was absolutely delicious. Had food amount of chicke and fries in it with generous amount of sauce as well.
• Schezwan Style Chicken Rice Bowl:- This one bowl is absolutely enough to satisfy your rice cravings. Great quantity with great flavours.

featured_reviews.name: The hungry Tales
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wraps and rolls serves delicious food. They a a variety of of different wraps, rolls, shwarma and rice bowl.

What i ordered for?
1) Harissa Chicken Shwarma: The shwarma was on spicer side and was made to perfection. It had nice flavour of harissa.

2) Panner Tikka roll: Pieces of paneer was stuffed with some onions and chutney. The flavour was spicy and tangy

3) Schezwan Chicken Rice bowl: The rice bowl had Schezwan fried rice with tender pieces of chicken in it.

Overall loved the food. The quality and quantity was amazing according to rates

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Kesarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wrap & rolls is one of the best outlet around Juhu. Impressed with the packaging of food. Last night I had ordered,

"Thai Chicken Roll" : In this you will get a pure thai taste with a good portion of stuffing. At low prices they are giving such a delicious rolls.

featured_reviews.name: Rachna Chirania
featured_reviews.review_text:

We ordered -
1. Smoky paneer cheese roll - this was really good, cheesy and fresh. Paneer was super fresh.
2. Smoky cheese chicken roll - it was good, the chicken was fresh and it was really tasty. Must try.
3. Japanese teriyaki paneer rice bowl - this was good but felt the sauce could be little less would taste better.

featured_reviews.name: rohan kucheriya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wraps and Rolls a good place to fix your cravings and from now onwards will be my goto option for ordering wraps for a quick snack. Apt packaging, well done food which was delivered to me well in time, also lovely offers on Zomato/Swiggy making my experience a complete treat to be. Menu consists of variety of wraps, rice bowls and some side options, from which I ordered Mexican style Paneer & Cheese Roll,  Japanese Style Teriyaki Paneer Rice Bowl and Peri Peri Fries. Food was delectable but the only thing I was disappointed with was quantity they delivered, hope they fix this soon.

Mexican style Paneer & Cheese Roll which I customized to Beet Roomali Wrap, was spiced Paneer wrapped in Beet Roomali with refried beans, salsa and cheese. It was delicious!

Japanese Style Teriyaki Paneer Rice Bowl was a vegetable fried rice bowl with added paneer cooked in Teriyaki sauce. This was delectable too!

All in all  definitely looking forward to order from here again, it was a homely, amazing experience to eating food from you guys. Thank you Wraps & Rolls!

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: This famous cafe which serves peri peri fried chicken, pizza, pasta and many more such dishes. I had tried the peri peri fried chicken which was mild spicy because of the seasoning but the juicy and tender meat was too good. It was perfectly crisp from the outside. Also, the pasta was really delicious. It was loaded with veggies, sauces, chicken and cheese. Here you will also get cold coffee and mocktails. They also various different platters which could be a good option to share within the group. Really this cafe is excellent in serving fried chicken.

featured_reviews.name: Food Of Prashu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved our experience here! This quick service restaurant in Bandra is a gem for fried chicken aficionados. The fried chicken platter boasts succulent drumsticks, each one expertly seasoned and fried to golden perfection. Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside – it's a true flavor explosion with every bite.

But wait, there's more! Their mozzarella sticks are a delightful addition to any meal, with gooey cheese encased in a crunchy coating. Dip them in their selection of zesty sauces for an extra burst of flavor. And please don’t miss their newly launched buff burgers too!

The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for a quick bite with friends or family. And the service is top-notch – friendly staff ensure you have everything you need for a satisfying meal.

Located conveniently in Bandra, this spot is a must-visit for anyone craving delicious food!

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
📍Carter’s Quickeats, Bandra

Chef Varun's Carter's Quickeats is a culinary haven for those craving delicious and satisfying fast food delights.It has a vibrant eatery that tantalizes taste buds with an array of mouthwatering offerings.The menu at Carter's Quickeats boasts a variety of options to please every palate. Sink your teeth into juicy chicken burgers, for those looking for a smaller bite, the sliders offer a perfect solution, packed with flavor in every bite.
We JUST LOVED the food and here’s what we ordered -

Bhut Chicken tenders pasta - Every bite is a journey of flavors, from the comforting creaminess of the pasta to the bold heat of the spicy chicken tenders.

Melted Mozzarella chicken strips - Creamy and cheesy crispy chicken strips with some spicy peri peri fries was a perfect combo!

Peri peri chicken burger wuth egg sliders - A symphony of textures and tastes. If you're a spice enthusiast or simply love bold flavors,      you should definitely try this !

BBQ pizza - The pizza was so cheesy and the sweet and smoky notes of the barbecue sauce melted harmoniously with the creamy richness of the cheese.

Mango delight thickshake - It's a refreshing and satisfying treat that's perfect for cooling down on a hot day or simply satisfying your sweet tooth .

Chocolate brownie Nutella-A combination of rich chocolate and creamy Nutella hazelnut spread which is also a perfect treat to all the chocolate lovers !

At Carter's Quickeats, quality and flavor are always the top priorities. Whether you're grabbing a quick bite on the go or settling in for a leisurely meal, Chef Varun's culinary creations promise a memorable dining experience that will leave you craving more !

featured_reviews.name: Vansh Gulati
featured_reviews.review_text:

Their menu items aren't outstanding by any margin but very good, and the vibe here is simply amazing. The owner/manager was super chill. It was raining outside and Bollywood night inside.

We tried their garlic bread, chicken sandwich and Mozarella sticks - all were good. Next, we tried their Bhut Jolokia menu which was WAY spicy. Loved it!

And they have this special cold coffee, that's absolutely delicious. Sadly, we could only get one of it because it was almost sold out.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Our go-to munching spot in Lower Parel!
KK Rolls has always been our favourite place whenever we’re in Lower Parel. The rolls are absolutely yummy, the drinks are refreshing, and the uncle at the counter is super welcoming as always! Their takeaway packing is superb too — neat, sturdy, and perfect for on-the-go cravings.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Neha Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text: Delicious is the only way I would describe the rolls here! The staff and owners are incredibly friendly and knowledgeable and their suggestions proved to be super useful! Drove all the way from Kandivali and let me tell you it was totally worth it! Definitely coming back for more!

featured_reviews.name: Joanna Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best rolls in Mumbai, no doubt!
Fresh naan, fresh fillings, you can actually taste it.
So many options and still soooo affordable (like actually affordable).
One roll and you’re full for hours!
The Kolkata egg roll tho… insane.
Simple, basic.
And the owner is super sweet.
Will help you out and suggest stuff if you’re confused, which just makes it better.

featured_reviews.name: Aashay Nandoskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I will start with the cons
Only con is its location: There is no seating arrangement and parking can be hassle. (But honestly, these guys can do very little about it).

Apart from that- Excellent food, the rolls are fresh, chicken is well cooked and fresh, spices are good and service couldn't get any better. The owner of the shop is a sweet Marathi gentleman who gives you really great recommendations as per your taste pallet and is very humble and friendly to converse with.

100% Recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Ayat Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text: A perfect place to have tasty and delicious rolls. The roti used is laccha Paratha and not maida which makes it healthy. Overall the place is highly recommended, just that there is no seating options available.
